_comment: Published aerodrome opening hours (UK local time) used for the radio strip's open/closed estimate. The 'service_hours' setting overrides these when set. Always record the source and the date checked.

EGSU.ppr: Strictly PPR at all times by telephone
EGSU.source: IWM Duxford pilot information (iwm.org.uk): opening hours (local) mid-March to mid-October 1000-1800, winter 1000-1600; out-of-hours on request. 'Mid-month' interpreted as the 15th.
